title: Micro-evidence sprintboard — manager prep and ask log
content:
Purpose: quick rolling log for 4-week micro-evidence used for 1:1 prep, skip-level highlights, and a compact ‘ask’ list. Keep short, timestamped snippets. Use this in the 1:1 pre-reads and add one line per meaningful outcome or signal.

Top focuses (this sprint):
- Reduce time to close headcount requisitions: improve intake -> 30% faster (target).
- Streamline onboarding checklist: automation for 1st-week tooling access.
- Manager enablement: run 3 office-hours for new managers on performance conversations.

Signals / micro-evidence (timestamped):
- 2026-01-12: Drafted revised intake form + dropped in #people-ops. Early feedback: hiring managers say form is clearer. Link to form (Confluence).
- 2026-01-18: Completed first automated invite flow for new hire infra access; blocked on infra token rotation (ticket PEOPLE-821). Reduced manual invites from 6 -> 2 steps in pilot (ops team).
- 2026-01-26: Ran manager office-hours (12 attendees). Post-survey: 83% said session helped frame next 1:1. Attach survey excerpt in pre-read.
- 2026-02-04: Partnered with Eng Recruiting on two role templates; saved ~2 hours of back-and-forth per req in the pilot (estimate).
- 2026-02-15: Coached Ajay through performance calibration; he implemented 1:1 agenda template — early qualitative win (mood and clarity improved).
- 2026-02-28: Onboarding automation test with infra team failed when running on staging due to permission mismatch; raised follow-up with SRE (SRE ticket SRE-332).

Recent wins (short bullets):
- Reduced average time to first PR review for new hires by pushing reviewer reminders (pilot) — anecdotal positives from two managers.
- Manager enablement deck (v0.2) circulated and co-reviewed with Ravi.
- One fewer escalated on-boarding delay this month vs last (small N but directionally good).

Energy map / capacity notes (how I felt while doing the work):
- High energy 01/11-01/20: good focus on templates and intake.
- Low energy 02/21-02/26: context switching heavy; pulled backlog tasks into a week bucket to avoid fragmentation.
- Need: 2 consecutive focus days to close the onboarding automation (ask below).

Stop / Start / Continue (short actions)
- Stop: chasing managers for minor form edits in Slack — instead, consolidate changes weekly.
- Start: 30-min weekly office-hour focused on hiring blockers for managers (pilot).
- Continue: running mini-postmortems for onboarding delays (keeps small fixes incremental).

Concrete asks for next 1:1 (ranked):
1) Prioritized unblock for infra permission on staging (ask SRE allocation: 4h dedicated this sprint).
2) Support to re-prioritize one headcount approval meeting slot weekly (need manager-level backing).
3) Budget ask: $2k for an onboarding tooling prototype (one-time) — quick ROI: save time and reduce delays.

Draft one-line TL;DR for manager pre-read:
- "Improved intake and manager enablement show early signal of reduced onboarding friction; blocked on infra permission for automation — asking 4h SRE support + quick budget approval for prototype."

Potential risks / mitigations:
- Risk: infra delay pushes automation to next quarter. Mitigation: deliver smaller manual-to-automated checklist as interim step and document handoff.
- Risk: manager time scarcity reduces adoption of new templates. Mitigation: champion pilot with two manager partners and gather concrete time-savings anecdotes to make adoption easier.

Evidence snippets to pull into promotion/compilation doc later (copy these lines to promotion-evidence doc when ready):
- "Led 3 manager office-hours; post-survey 83% positive; managers reported clearer 1:1 outcomes."
- "Reduced manual invite steps in onboarding pilot from 6 to 2 (blocked on infra token rotation)."
- "Saved ~2 hours per req during role-template pilot with recruiting (estimate from feedback)."

Meeting prep checklist (for the 1:1 where I use this doc):
- Send this file 24h before meeting.
- Highlight top 3 asks at start.
- Bring one short customer quote (manager) about the template.
- Ask for explicit commitment on SRE time or alternate path.

Notes / fragments (scratch):
- Could try a rapid A/B of intake forms with two teams — quick numbers in two weeks?
- Might be able to get $1k from manager development budget instead of central. Check Amelia.
- Add micro-OKR: "Decrease onboarding manual steps by 50% for roles with standard infra needs".

Todo (short):
- [ ] Consolidate feedback for intake form (due 2026-03-15).
- [ ] Follow up with SRE on permission matrix (SRE-332).
- [ ] Draft budget note for tooling prototype and circulate to Ravi / Amelia.

Quick links referenced:
- Confluence: PEOPLE-OKR-2026 intake form draft (paste link in linked_artifacts).
- Linear: PEOPLE-821 (automation blocker).
- Slack thread: #people-ops-hiring (posted 2026-01-12).

End of sprintboard. Keep it lean. Add one-line evidence whenever there's something measurable.
